content: 13:1-6 Maigas at Qenu qenungouboun
An Yisas wonou yurau end munon gugum qibanamsi igoarar.
Munon qei aninou munai mor end yarari wuriba mor bigar. Qoan munon qei ebetemir eng: Enger yarari wuri qoyam ue, munon ar qamb wuriba mor bigumir eng.
Munon qei uyort igamari gab eng an gor uyort igamau gas ende igoarar. A qei git goan uter igara aruab abari eng an gor ende gas at igoarar.

Munon yamangar gugum qibaiau qomon eng sig uber. Qi baiau qomon eng wagari mi ger qiginnob gas ende wagari Qenu magqurt igoriner. Umami ubeni nob qoregen igorunor. Munon qiyo yamangar ende qibaub wogub qomon biisitet song-song yamangar qiyo munon nob qirunor eng, Qenu wurinou qomon eng qereimba.

Ne gor, an nomon qur baub qamb inab aruab ende me abar. Nomon qur qiyo mind gari-gari baub gab eng mom, mi eng annonogursi igoriba. End Qenu qob qo qamar eng igo, ‘Ye an mogirt wab wogub me igorinei, anigusub ten igoribam.’
Qob eng igo end ne in end yoosi ete at qomorun:

content.text: Munon Aib yemusub igo end ye mit qoot qiyo me yariemin. Munon qei meimi ger me yesiorunorei.

content: 13:7-16 In Yisas wot me qininingun
Ende qamb aninou munon baraitari end wurit igar. Qoan wuri Qenu qob dibes aninob qamarari igumon eng. Wurinou qomon ne oau apand eng an woropar qib igoarar.
Yisas wonou qomon eng barim igoar eng ne see igo ne qenen ende igoriba.

An abari misir soagen end yarab misir uber eng bumaima Qenu wonou werei uber eng at wogunon. Ininou misir eng Qenu inmusub igo qamb gab eng uber. Mi niau qomon wes-wes igo end ininou misir me nonogursiorunei. Qomon eng gagar munon yamangar wurinonogursia me igour.
In mian yab bigau nam qab igo. End munon mian yamau wuri Yuda wurit mon urumun end mian yab nam qab end big wuri me nunorei.

Ne mian yamau munon barai gigit eng wuri sipsip ne bur qarig qeru qas ba munai tumbigi sig qau end isub Yuda wurinou qomon boru end wurit yab maragansi igour. Wai git eng munai ginam ag end mutet wab igour.
End ne Yisas gor munai ginam aib ag git goan uter wara umor end wonou qeru end munon gugum wurimaragansier end munon qau igour.
End ne in gor ginam aib ag end isub wo quguragetar gas ende in gor quguragetorun.
Munai ginam aib ger ag et qenen me igo. In munai ginam aib qen geret dieriner eng qoat igorun.
End in Yisas gab-gab Qenut qenen mismisir igorun. Mismisiroau eng mian yamau gas ende Qenu menmant ebet igorun. In qabari eng wonou wot wogub ne wonou unum dibes qamb igorun.
Qomon uber toat ebet munon qibanamsiau eng ininomi tetemi. Qomon eng Qenut mian yab bigau gas ende gab mismisir igoriba.
13:17-21 Qenu inseara uber igoun

Aninou munon baraitari im ibag wuri qob qamarari toat igoarar. Wuri musub anoar igo qen geret sarau obounor end Qenu nob qomorubour. An end obounon eng wuri me quguragetorunorei. An wurinou qob omboarir ende obounon eng an gor me nonoguretorunanei.
In misir igoun eng in Qenu magqurt qoregen igoun. End an innonogursi Qenu nob qamarari in qenen Qenu magqurt qoregen qib igorub.
Ne gor ye anit qand yarib misir igoum, end an Qenu qebi qamarari werei ger yiimbiga yarin.
Qenu wo oau mein end qomon bubun qenen igoriner end ininou Munon aib Yisas menima der bugamorei. End Yisas wo wai sipsip oroar igamau tari.

End Qenu wonou qomon uber eng anboopuri ten igama wonou qenungar end qas toat igoarar. Ne gor in gugum Yisas unumut wonou qomon qenungar eng inboopuri ten igama igorun. Wonou gari unum qiribiten qenen igoriba. Apand.
13:22-25 Qob sasam
An yonou munon banam, end qob e qugiab aninob qemeribam eng aninou misir end nonogursi igoarar. Namanimun e gumaum eng piten.
End ininou munon banam Timoti uyort igoar eng bo wagari ar igo. End wo yet qand diara eng yenob ombur yar animbogouboun.
In qob eng aninob quraun eng imusi aninou munon baraitari eng ne Qenut oabig igour yurau eng wurinob qamarar. Ne Yisas yurau ai Itali wogub ininob igour eng gor anit uber quraur.
Qenu wonou oau mein eng an boopuri ten igoriner.
